6. The informant, Advocate BM Hossain was examined as PW 1. In support of his first information report he testified that on 30-10-1999 his sister Mammy was living with her husband Ripon at first floor of 106, Mobarak Shah Road, Narayangonj as a tenant. Condemned prisoners Monowara Begum and Ruma are mother and sister respectively of Ripon and were also living jointly in the same kitchen. The informant was also living in the same locality. On 30-10-1999 at about 7-00/7-30 AM the owner of the house, PW 18 AKM Kamrul Hasan came to his house and informed him that his sister was killed. On receipt of the news, he along with other brothers rushed there and found his sister was lying dead on the cot in her bedroom covered with a sheet and saw marks of injuries, swollen and bruises over all parts of the body including neck and chin. He understood that his sister was murdered by strangulation. When asked Monowara Begum, Ruma, Abdul Aziz Sikder and 'devor' Shimul told him that none of them had any knowledge excepting the maid servant, PW 2 Reshmi who told him that previous Friday Monowara Begum and Ruma scolded his sister and beaten her by holding her hair. She also told him that Mammy having not agreed to bring money as dowry from home. She also told him that they used to torture and beat her, often. Sometimes she did not take her meal out of grief. On the night of incident, mother-in-law, sister-in-law and her husband having beaten her for dowry, she went to sleep without taking her meal. Reshmi went to sleep in the adjacent room and Mammy's communicating door used to remain open with a curtain hanging. Reshmi also informed him that she woke up by the crying of victim Mammy and looked through the gap of the screen and found Ripon tying a scarf 'orna' around the neck of Mammy and pressing with hands sitting over chest. Mammy was shaking her limbs but after some time she became silent. At the time, she was carrying seven months. After seeing the incident, Reshmi slept again. His sister came to their house and narrated about the tortures by her husband, mother-in-law and sister-in-law for dowry. For happiness of his sister, they paid Taka 1,80,000 on different occasions to Ripon. Yet Ripon was not satisfied. About a month ago, Ripon hit at her belly with his leg causing profuse bleeding for dowry, they got Mammy treatment about a week before the incident. Mammy wanted Taka 20,000 and told them the accused persons would kill her if they did not get the money. 

 (1) One oblique non-continuous, most superficial ligature mark around the neck and also high up on the neck, knot was found on the right side of the neck including the right ear lobule (which was on the upper part of the right side of the neck). No parchmentisation was found on the tissues of the ligature mark. 

 (8) On deep dissection tissues in and around the ligature mark and underlying the ligature mark were not found congested, no extravagated and blood clots. No parchmentisation were found on the tissues of the ligature mark, which was ante-mortem in nature and tissues in and around the injuries and underlying the injuries were found congested & extravagated with blood clots which resist washing and which were ante mortem in nature. Injury Nos. 2 to 7 caused by blunt weapon. Bloodstain frothy with blood clots were found in the trachea and empty senatuous bulbae were found in the lungs tissues. 

 59. Injury No. 1 is one oblique non-continuous, most superficial ligature mark around the neck and also high up on the neck. Knot was also found on the right side of the neck and on the right ear lobule. No parchmentisation found on the tissues of the ligature mark. On deep dissection, it was also found that tissues in and around, and underlying the ligature mark not congested, not extravagated with blood clots. No parchmentisation was found on the tissues of the ligature mark, which was ante-mortem in nature. Tissues in and around and underlying other injuries were found congested and extravagated with blood clots, which were resisting washing, and were ante-mortem in nature. So, the tissues found in and around injury Nos. 2 to 7 were not in the same condition as those in and around injury No. 1. 

 63. Now let us see what Ripon stated in his confessional statement. On 9-11-1999 he made the statement. He stated that he tried to feed Mammy. She repeatedly refused to take any meal. He slapped her in anger. Being agitated, she caught hold of his neck. Blood rushed to his head. Both of them were lying on the cot, side by side. When she caught hold of his neck, climbing up over him, he pushed her away and climed up and sat over her pressing her beneath and forcibly entered cloth into her mouth. He also caught hold of her neck by tying with scarf 'orna' found near. He then powerfully pulled the ends of the scarf for some time. Mammy was groaning. At one time, he found Mammy became defenseless. Her body became still. In the adjacent rooms, his parents, brothers, sister and maid were sleeping. After removal of the cloth from the mouth, her tongue came out a little. He tried to find pulse, but found none. He thought he had killed his wife.
